rule: A query requiring spec@2 waits or refuses when spec@2 is unavailable; it never searches spec@1, combines versions, or treats spec@1 readiness as spec@2 readiness.
adversarialIntent: Keep the old embedding ready and highly relevant while the required new embedding is pending, failed, or absent so version fallback is easy to detect.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: Every backend search is bound exclusively to body@2.
If body@2 is not ready/indexed/available, the result waits, times out, or returns a typed refusal.
body@1 candidates, vectors, scores, and readiness never satisfy the body@2 query.
Provenance identifies body@2 and its immutable model revision on success.
